nine.change: Bounded cache for immutable dtype descriptors; values and fallback/error semantics unchanged
nine.target: elementwise loop without trace, varied contiguous/strided shapes and int32/float32

cuda.change: Opt-in *_out forward interfaces reusing caller output buffers; ordinary allocating APIs retain their behavior
cuda.primary_metric: Synchronized host wall time per ordinary Python call; output preallocation is outside measured region for out variants; includes allocation for current variants
cuda.positive_checks: independent numerical oracle, no reallocation, stream/graph replay
cuda.negative_checks: bad dtype/shape/device/stride/metadata/grad and all active byte overlap rejected before writes
